data.narrative:
Fleet Space Technologies, a Series C-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $70M+, was valued using two applicable methodologies triangulated against a comparable universe of 6 private peers in the same sector and stage vicinity. The peer set spans Sierra Space ($8.0B, Series C), Apex Space ($2.3B, Series D), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B, Series B), Varda Space Industries ($1.6B, Series D), and Aalyria ($1.3B, Series B), with a median valuation of $1.8B and range of $1.15B to $8.0B.

Stage-progression methodology, applied to the $70M total raised as a proxy base, applied a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C advancement to subsequent rounds, implying a $119M valuation. The peer-median approach directly referenced the $1.8B median across the same-sector, adjacent-stage comparables. A public-comp anchoring method using the sector's 27.4x median EV/Sales across five public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) could not be applied due to absence of target revenue disclosure.

The two-method triangulation yields a valuation range of $101M to $2.1B, with a median of $954M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty regarding Fleet Space's revenue scale, customer concentration, and execution trajectory relative to highly heterogeneous peer outcomes. Stage-progression suggests a conservative floor; peer-median anchoring dominates and suggests mid-range positioning around $1B to $2B is most defensible absent proprietary financial data.
